welcome.title: Welcome to Jobgoblin
welcome.description: A calm helper for your job search. You decide everything; it does the legwork.
welcome.promise: Jobgoblin finds jobs, checks how well each one fits you, and prepares a truthful resume for the best ones. Nothing is sent to a company unless you approve it.

steps.folder: Choose a folder for your files
steps.story: Check what we found in it
steps.answers: Fill in the answers forms ask for
steps.targets: Say what kind of job you want

welcome.time: This usually takes about fifteen minutes.

connect.title: Connect Claude
connect.description: Jobgoblin does its thinking with your own Claude plan, so there is no extra subscription.

folder.title: Choose your folder
folder.description: Your resumes, application folders and spreadsheets are kept here, on your computer. A folder in Google Drive or OneDrive also gives you an online copy.
folder.backupsTitle: We found backups in this folder
folder.backupsDescription: Restore one to carry on where you left off, or continue below to start fresh.

resume.title: Add your resume
resume.description: Choose your resume as a PDF or Word file. Claude reads it and drafts the story of your work for you to check.
resume.resumeHint: A PDF or Word file, up to 10 MB.
resume.linkedinHint: On LinkedIn, choose Save to PDF on your profile and add the file here for more detail. Add it before you read your resume.
resume.privacy: Your name, email, phone number and address are taken out of the text before Claude reads it. Claude never sees them.
resume.tooBig: {{name}} is larger than {{size}}. Choose a smaller file.
resume.done: Your resume has been read. Next, check what we found.

continueHint.addResume: Add your resume and read it to continue.
continueHint.readFirst: Choose Read my resume to continue.
continueHint.reading: Continue opens when your resume has been read.

story.title: Your story
story.description: This is what Claude found in your resume. Keep what is true, fix what is off, and drop what does not belong. Only what you confirm is ever used in a resume.

empty.title: We did not find anything yet
empty.description: Go back and add a resume, or add details by hand later in Profile.

answers.title: Form answers
answers.description: Application forms ask the same things again and again. Fill them in once here. Answers Claude suggested from your resume are filled in already, so check each one.

targets.title: Your targets
targets.description: Tell Jobgoblin what you are looking for, and what to leave out. You can change this any time.

finish.title: You are ready
finish.description: One last click, and Jobgoblin is yours.
finish.confirmed_one: 1 item in your story is confirmed.
finish.confirmed_other: {{count}} items in your story are confirmed.
finish.missing_one: 1 answer is still missing. You can add it later in Profile.
finish.missing_other: {{count}} answers are still missing. You can add them later in Profile.
finish.noneMissing: Every form answer is filled in.
finish.next: Next you will see Today. Choose Find jobs there to look for your first roles.
